harm_description: Incorrect cancer treatment recommendations due to insufficient training data on diverse patient populations and complex oncology cases
existing_controls: None documented in the public case - system relied on vendor claims without independent validation
proposed_controls: Implement mandatory independent clinical validation before deployment; require diverse training data certification; establish physician oversight committee for all recommendations
human_oversight: Subspecialist oncologists review all treatment recommendations before patient communication; human-in-the-loop with final treatment decision authority
monitoring_metric: Recommendation agreement rate between AI and physician panel
trigger_threshold: Below 85% agreement rate on validation set
response_action: Suspend system deployment pending re-validation and retraining

high_risk_moment: Initial triage and care level recommendation
harm_description: Algorithmic recommendations that perpetuate historical healthcare disparities by using race-correlated features that do not reflect biological differences
existing_controls: None documented in general - healthcare organizations increasingly conducting algorithmic audits
proposed_controls: Require demographic parity testing across all model versions; use fairness metrics with multiple definitions; mandate separate evaluation for each protected group
human_oversight: Clinical lead reviews all triage recommendations with demographic breakdown; escalation protocols include equity audit triggers
monitoring_metric: Subgroup parity metrics across race ethnicity age and gender
trigger_threshold: Any statistically significant disparity above 5% threshold between groups
response_action: Pause affected workflow and convene equity review committee

harm_description: Patients rely on chatbot reassurance instead of seeking professional care for symptoms requiring medical evaluation leading to delayed diagnosis and treatment
existing_controls: Disclaimer text in interface - but research shows users frequently ignore disclaimers
proposed_controls: Strengthen escalation prompts for red flag symptoms; implement check-back questions to verify user understanding; add mandatory acknowledgment for emergency-level recommendations
human_oversight: Physician on-call available for escalation; customer support trained to identify over-reliance patterns; audit trail for all triage recommendations
monitoring_metric: Triage accuracy rate and delayed-care incident rate
trigger_threshold: Below 97% appropriate escalation rate for emergency-level cases
response_action: Immediate notification to clinical team; patient follow-up call within 24 hours; incident review within 48 hours

harm_description: Chatbot provides incorrect medication interaction information leading to adverse drug events or inappropriate medication decisions
existing_controls: Medication database licensing - but AI generation can hallucinate
proposed_controls: Implement retrieval-augmented generation from validated medication databases only; remove any generative medication advice; display only database-verified information
human_oversight: Pharmacist review of all medication-related outputs before patient delivery; mandatory database citation for all medication information
monitoring_metric: Medication information accuracy rate on audit tests
trigger_threshold: Below 99% accuracy on monthly medication database audit
response_action: Immediately escalate to pharmacist review; notify affected users; update system with verified correction
